messages:
mohit: Massive thanks to @izzy for the late-night deploy rescue and for rescuing the sad pothos from the meeting-room windowsill this morning. true multi-tasking hero :sparkles: :plant:
izzy: haha surprised anyone noticed the plant. surprised-er that the deploy didn't melt down after the db index change. team effort though! :muscle:
fran: shoutout for the calm rollback suggestion — avoided a cascade. also +1 on the plant CPR, looks perky now. :raised_hands: :seedling:
mohit: suggestion: stamp a 'sunrise saver' sticker on izzy's laptop and log it in the kudos sheet. vote with :sticker: below
fran: :sticker: :coffee: (i'll bring matcha)
izzy: i'll accept the sticker and matcha bribe. thank you folks! 
ops-bot: deploy-bot: auto-notice: rollback performed at 23:48 UTC. duration: 12m.
kudos-bot: logged: recipient=izzy points=5 reason="late-night deploy rollback + meeting-room pothos rescue"
mohit: added to #kudos-log and team morale tracker: https://docs.example.com/kudos-log. tiny ceremony at 10:15 by the snack shelf?
fran: I'm in. i'll make paper stickers so we can actually hand one over. 
izzy: i'll practice my acceptance speech. fair warning: it might be emotional. :grin:
mohit: ok, see you all then — thanks again @izzy, saved the demo handoff and our office greenery :heart:
